prayerExcerpt.en-US: Follow me, says the Lord, and I will make you into fishers of men.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Vinde após mim, diz o Senhor, e eu farei de vós pescadores de homens.

meta.face: A robust, clean-shaven priest of about sixty-five with a broad, round face and full cheeks, dark hair greying at the temples, combed straight back from a high forehead, dark eyes behind heavy dark-rimmed rectangular spectacles, and a wide, cheerful smile.
meta.basis: His photographs of the 1960s–70s and the official Opus Dei prayer card: a round, smiling face, dark hair combed back and dark-rimmed glasses, in a black cassock. The glasses are rectangular and dark to keep him apart from Kolbe's round wire spectacles.

sources.title: Opus Dei, St Josemaría prayer card (official photograph)
